text1: The station called the Shattered Ring has been built through the largest surviving arc of an ancient adamantine megastructure. Habitats, docks, revival wards, and salvage gantries cling to the fracture like barnacles. The surrounding debris is divided into jealously guarded orbital claims known as wreck-farms. Generations of salvagers have worked these plots, drawing metals, machinery, intact hull sections, and the occasional living cryopod from a field that has never quite run dry.
